message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary-product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`. Obvious naming variants and duplicates were normalized across those two files; headings, blank lines, and clearly administrative/project-only rows were excluded. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-04 05:10 IST through 2026-10-05 05:10 IST** (2026-10-03 23:40 through 2026-10-04 23:40 UTC).

**No credible, newly reported vulnerabilities were found that both fall within the exact 24-hour window and confidently match the combined primary-product scope.**

### Freshness and match review

- A Bouncy Castle for Java CVE batch was checked because Bouncy Castle appears in the SIA inventory. The authoritative CVE records were published around 08:38-08:55 UTC on October 3, roughly 15 hours before this run's cutoff, so they were excluded as stale for this digest.
- A Guyana National CIRT notice dated October 4 concerns Chrome, but it points to Google's September 29 Stable Channel update and Canada's October 1 advisory. It was excluded because the underlying vulnerability disclosure/update falls outside the window.
- An October 4 Fortinet roundup concerned the FortiMail issue disclosed October 1. FortiMail is not the listed FortiOS/FortiWeb product scope, and the disclosure is outside the window, so it was excluded.
- Newly published October 4 CVE/advisory records for unrelated products and unlisted WordPress plugins were rejected as product mismatches.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD-oriented records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA-oriented reporting.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within the exact 24-hour window. MongoDB's official alerts page showed no security advisory within the window.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [Guyana National CIRT Chrome advisory](https://cirt.gy/article/adv2026_645-google-security-advisory-october-4th-2026/)
- [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security Chrome advisory](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/google-security-advisory-av26-984)
- [Fortinet PSIRT advisories](https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt)
- [Mozilla Foundation security advisories](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/)
- [Ubuntu Security Notices](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices)

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based solely on vulnerabilities newly reported in this 24-hour window. Continue routine monitoring and handle older applicable advisories through the existing vulnerability backlog.
